content.text: I reviewed every input file, all ten draft sections, the numeral ledger, and all seven figure briefs, and built a full limitation-by-limitation ledger against the disclosure.

input.summary: Full source-fidelity preflight completed. I traced every limitation of all 22 claims (apparatus claims 1-12, second apparatus claim 13-17, method claims 18-22), every entry in draft/numerals.md (10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 24, 26, 30, 32, 34, 36, 40, 50, 52, 54, 58, 60, 62, 70, 72, 74, 78, 80, 82, 90, 92, 94), every sentence of the title, field, summary, brief description of drawings, detailed description and abstract, and every statement in the FIG. 1-7 briefs, back to affirmative USER passages in input/disclosure.md (the conversation.md USER passage is an identical but truncated copy and adds nothing). Supported items include: elongated straight rail with flat lower face, upper face, straight longitudinal slot and printed distance marks beside the slot; fixed fence at the first end, perpendicular to the rail, with a downwardly projecting portion bearing on the workpiece edge; reversibility by two screws in two corresponding holes moving the projecting portion from one longitudinal side to the opposite side while the same marked upper face is used; removable spacer plate with parallel opposite faces changing setback by its thickness without changing separation; two separate guide carriages with anti-rotation keys in the slot, one cylindrical drill bushing each with a bore passing completely through the carriage and registering with the slot, the two bore axes parallel and perpendicular to the flat lower face; threaded clamp knob above the rail with a shank through carriage and slot into a clamping shoe below the rail that clamps the rail between carriage and shoe; a pointer on each carriage aligned with its bore axis and readable against the distance marks, whose reading difference is the center-to-center spacing; transverse center index at the rail midpoint; shallow V-shaped sight notch in the second end aligned with the center index; the recited method sequence (select spacing, loosen, slide to readings centered about the index, tighten, place, press fence or spacer against the edge, align notch and index with the pencil centerline, drill both bushings, lift away with nothing left attached); hardened-metal replaceable bushings; rigid polymer or metal for rail, fence, carriage bodies, shoes, spacer plate, pointers and knobs; and the no-motor/no-battery/no-sensor/no-network limitation. Figure conventions were checked for verbalized but undisclosed geometry: the schematic blocks, round bodies, plain rectangular fence, elongated slot opening and V-notch add no depth direction, taper, angle, runout, order of the offset section legs, or contact topology beyond the disclosure; the offset cutting planes 3-3 and 5-5 use the same repeated designation in FIG. 2, in the FIG. 3 and FIG. 5 briefs and in the Brief Description; and the FIG. 7 lengthwise alignment of centerline 94 with the sight notch and the midpoint of the transverse center index is a necessary implication of the disclosed statements that the notch is "aligned with the center index" and that the user "align[s] the center index and the sight notch with a pencil centerline," so it is traced rather than reported, though the disclosure's own geometry on that point is thin. No drafting note, placeholder, open question, unresolved alternative, "by way of example" shape hedge or internal comment remains, each numeral means exactly one part, and claims and description use the same relationships and terms. One verified defect was found: the detailed description cites FIG. 1 for reference characters 58 and 78, which FIG. 1 neither labels nor lists.

findings.title: Description cites FIG. 1 for clamp knobs 58 and 78, which FIG. 1 does not label or list
findings.where: draft/08-detailed-description.md (clamping paragraph) vs. figures/FIG-1.md (body and "Numerals shown on this figure")
findings.detail: The detailed description directs the reader to FIG. 1 for reference characters 58 and 78, but the FIG. 1 brief numbers only 10, 30, 32, 50, 70, 90 and 92. FIG. 1 does depict the knobs ("A plain round body, shown schematically, stands above each of the two blocks"), but leaves them unnumbered, so two reference characters mentioned in the specification as appearing in FIG. 1 will not appear in that view. This is an internal inconsistency between the description and the figure brief and a 37 CFR 1.84(p)(5) defect (reference characters mentioned in the description must appear in the drawings). The clamp knob itself is fully source-supported, so the mismatch is a labeling gap, not an unsupported structure.
findings.evidence: Description: "Each guide carriage has a threaded clamp knob above the rail 10, a clamp knob 58 (FIGS. 1 and 5) on the first guide carriage 50 and a clamp knob 78 (FIGS. 1 and 3) on the second guide carriage 70." FIG-1.md body: "A plain round body, shown schematically, stands above each of the two blocks." FIG-1.md numeral list: "- 10: rail / - 30: fence / - 32: downwardly projecting portion / - 50: first guide carriage / - 70: second guide carriage / - 90: workpiece / - 92: workpiece edge" (no 58, no 78). Inventor support for the part itself: "Each carriage has a threaded clamp knob above the rail." (disclosure.md)
findings.fix: In figures/FIG-1.md, name and number the two round bodies and add them to the numeral list. Change the last sentence of the FIG. 1 body to: "A plain round body, shown schematically, stands above each of the two blocks, the body above the first guide carriage 50 being the clamp knob 58 of that carriage and the body above the second guide carriage 70 being the clamp knob 78 of that carriage." Add to the "Numerals shown on this figure" list: "- 58: clamp knob of the first guide carriage" and "- 78: clamp knob of the second guide carriage". (Equivalent alternative, if FIG. 1 is to stay unlabeled: change the description text to read "a clamp knob 58 (FIG. 5) ... and a clamp knob 78 (FIG. 3) ..." and delete the unnumbered round-body sentence from the FIG. 1 brief.)
